content.text:
发起 Lean 项目的计算机科学家是 **Leonardo de Moura**，他当时在微软研究院工作。2013 年，Lean 项目由他发起，第一个版本 Lean 0.1 在 2014 年发布。

依据：
- https://lean-lang.org/fro/about/ — “De Moura created Lean in 2013 and previously worked on automated reasoning and theorem proving at Microsoft Research…”
- https://graphsearch.epfl.ch/en/concept/62889984 — “It was launched by Leonardo de Moura at Microsoft Research in 2013.”
